name: Personal Information Safeguarding and Encryption Standard
standard: Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) Principle 7
what_it_decides: Requires personal identifiable information (PII) to be protected by security safeguards including encryption appropriate to the sensitivity of the data.

name: GST/HST Invoicing Requirements and Buyer Record Threshold
standard: Excise Tax Act (R.S.C., 1985, c. E-15) / Canada Revenue Agency Invoicing Rules
what_it_decides: Requires taxable supply transactions exceeding CAD 150 to record full recipient details including buyer name and terms of supply for input tax credit eligibility.

name: Privileged and Administrative Access Multi-Factor Authentication
standard: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (CCCS) ITSG-33 / Top 10 IT Security Actions (Action #2)
what_it_decides: Mandates multi-factor authentication (MFA) for administrative and privileged infrastructure operations to prevent credential-stuffing and unauthorized system modifications.

name: Automated Decision-Making Accountability and Human Oversight Directive
standard: Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat Directive on Automated Decision-Making Section 6.3
what_it_decides: Requires logged human oversight and decision auditability for high-impact automated operational workflows.
